movies.overview: A young social climber wins the heart of a beautiful heiress but his former girlfriend's pregnancy stands in the way of his ambition.
movies.title: A Place in the Sun
movies.tagline: Young people asking so much of life... taking so much of love!

movies.overview: A disturbed, aging Southern belle moves in with her sister for solace — but being face-to-face with her brutish brother-in-law accelerates her downward spiral.
movies.title: A Streetcar Named Desire
movies.tagline: ...Blanche, who wanted so much to stay a lady...

movies.overview: Jerry Mulligan is an exuberant American expatriate in Paris trying to make a reputation as a painter. His friend Adam is a struggling concert pianist who's a long time associate of a famous French singer, Henri Baurel. A lonely society woman, Milo Roberts, takes Jerry under her wing and supports him, but is interested in more than his art.
movies.title: An American in Paris
movies.tagline: What a joy! It's M-G-M's Technicolor musical!

movies.overview: At the start of the First World War, in the middle of Africa’s nowhere, a gin soaked riverboat captain is persuaded by a strong-willed missionary to go down river and face-off a German warship.
movies.title: The African Queen
movies.tagline: The greatest adventure a man ever lived… with a woman!

movies.overview: Tells the story of one day in the lives of the various people who populate a police detective squad. An embittered cop, Det. Jim McLeod, leads a precinct of characters in their grim daily battle with the city's lowlife. The characters who pass through the precinct over the course of the day include a young petty embezzler, a pair of burglars, and a naive shoplifter.
movies.title: Detective Story
movies.tagline: The love story of a man whose wife was more woman than angel!

movies.overview: Uncouth, loud-mouth junkyard tycoon Harry Brock descends upon Washington D.C. to buy himself a congressman or two, bringing with him his mistress, ex-showgirl Billie Dawn.
movies.title: Born Yesterday
movies.tagline: It's Here AT LAST!

movies.overview: WWII is entering its last phase: Germany is in ruins, but does not yield. The US army lacks crucial knowledge about the German units operating on the opposite side of the Rhine, and decides to send two German prisoners to gather information. The scheme is risky: the Gestapo retains a terribly efficient network to identify and capture spies and deserters. Moreover, it is not clear that "Tiger", who does not mind any dirty work as long as the price is right, and war-weary "Happy", who might be easily betrayed by his feelings, are dependable agents. After Tiger and another American agent are successfully infiltrated, Happy is parachuted in Bavaria. His duty: find out the whereabouts of a powerful German armored unit moving towards the western front.
movies.title: Decision Before Dawn
movies.tagline: A woman's kiss . . . A lighted cigarette - Each had Its meaning! An exciting and realistic story of war . . . of German Prisoners Sent Back Behind Their Own Lines as Agents of the Allies!

movies.overview: A meek bank clerk who oversees the shipments of bullion joins with an eccentric neighbor to steal gold bars and smuggle them out of the country.
movies.title: The Lavender Hill Mob
movies.tagline: The men who broke the bank and lost the cargo!

movies.overview: France, 1640. Cyrano, the charismatic swordsman-poet with the absurd nose, hopelessly loves the beauteous Roxane; she, in turn, confesses to Cyrano her love for the handsome but tongue-tied Christian. The chivalrous Cyrano sets up with Christian an innocent deception, with tragic results.
movies.title: Cyrano de Bergerac
movies.tagline: The Most Loved of All Love Stories!

movies.overview: Director Jean Renoir’s entrancing first color feature—shot entirely on location in India—is a visual tour de force. Based on the novel by Rumer Godden, the film eloquently contrasts the growing pains of three young women with the immutability of the Bengal river around which their daily lives unfold. Enriched by Renoir’s subtle understanding and appreciation for India and its people, The River gracefully explores the fragile connections between transitory emotions and everlasting creation.
movies.title: The River
movies.tagline: Beauty... Mystery... Delightful Humor...

movies.overview: King David enters into an adulterous affair with the beautiful Bathsheba, which has tragic consequences for his family and Israel.
movies.title: David and Bathsheba
movies.tagline: Mighty as Goliath!

movies.overview: Willy Loman, an aging, failing salesman, struggles to accept reality and his failure to achieve the American Dream.
movies.title: Death of a Salesman
movies.tagline: One mistake... seen by his sons... unleashes... in the overwhelming power... the greatest drama of our day!

movies.overview: After fierce Roman commander Marcus Vinicius becomes infatuated with beautiful Christian hostage Lygia, he begins to question the tyrannical leadership of the despotic emperor Nero.
movies.title: Quo Vadis
movies.tagline: THIS IS THE BIG ONE! The splendor and savagery of the world's wickedest empire! Three hours of spectacle you'll remember for a lifetime!

movies.overview: A soldier blinded in war returns home and attempts to adjust to civilian life.
movies.title: Bright Victory
movies.tagline: The great living love story of today's generation!

movies.overview: Enrico Caruso's only passion is to sing. For that, he leaves his hometown of Naples, Italy, and travels to America to sing for the Metropolitan Opera. At first, his lack of education and poor background make him an outcast in the high-class opera world. Eventually, his voice wins him both fans and the hand of his love, Dorothy. But his nonstop pace and desire to perform at any cost eventually take their toll on the singer's health.
movies.title: The Great Caruso
movies.tagline: The Intimate Story of a Man with a Voice as Great as His Heart!

movies.overview: A World War I widow loses her only child and spends the rest of her life as a children's nurse.
movies.title: The Blue Veil
movies.tagline: Who is the real Mother of this Child? The woman who gave it life... or the woman who gave it love?

movies.overview: A dashing Mississippi river gambler wins the affections of the daughter of the owner of the Show Boat.
movies.title: Show Boat
movies.tagline: It's NEW!

movies.overview: Henry Fleming is a young Union soldier in the American Civil War. During his unit's first engagement, Henry flees the battlefield in fear. When he learns that the Union actually won the battle, shame over his cowardice leads him to lie to his friend Tom and the other soldiers, saying that he had been injured in battle. However, when he learns that his unit will be leading a charge against the enemy, Henry takes the opportunity to face his fears and redeem himself.
movies.title: The Red Badge of Courage
movies.tagline: Stephen Crane's Great American Story of the Civil War

movies.overview: The story of Elwood P. Dowd who makes friends with a spirit taking the form of a human-sized rabbit named Harvey that only he sees (and a few privileged others on occasion also.) After his sister tries to commit him to a mental institution, a comedy of errors ensues. Elwood and Harvey become the catalysts for a family mending its wounds and for romance blossoming in unexpected places.
movies.title: Harvey
movies.tagline: The Wonderful Pulitzer Prize Play … becomes one of the Great Motion Pictures of our Time!

movies.overview: When strongman Samson rejects the love of the beautiful Philistine woman Delilah, she seeks vengeance that brings horrible consequences they both regret.
movies.title: Samson and Delilah
movies.tagline: HISTORY'S MOST BEAUTIFUL AND TREACHEROUS WOMAN!

movies.overview: When 9-year-old orphan Oliver Twist dares to ask his cruel taskmaster, Mr. Bumble, for a second serving of gruel, he's hired out as an apprentice. Escaping that dismal fate, young Oliver falls in with the street urchin known as the Artful Dodger and his criminal mentor, Fagin. When kindly Mr. Brownlow takes Oliver in, Fagin's evil henchman Bill Sikes plots to kidnap the boy.
movies.title: Oliver Twist
movies.tagline: A Screen Event To Be Remembered For All Time !

movies.overview: A successful, unorthodox doctor befriends a young woman with suicidal ideations due to her pregnancy by her ex, a military reservist killed in action.
movies.title: People Will Talk
movies.tagline: The picture that takes a new look at life!

movies.overview: A charming psychopath tries to coerce a tennis star into his theory that two strangers can commit the perfect crime by exchanging murders—each killing the other’s most-hated person.
movies.title: Strangers on a Train
movies.tagline: It starts with a shriek of a train whistle... and ends with shrieking excitement!

movies.overview: A young man, morally destroyed by his parents not loving him and by the fear of being not capable to make his girlfriend happy, rises on the ledge of a building with the intention of committing suicide. A policeman makes every effort to argue him out of it.
movies.title: Fourteen Hours
movies.tagline: A new element in screen suspense

movies.overview: In a racially mixed American town, a five-year-old black girl falls unnoticed into a hidden, forgotten well on her way to school. Having nothing better to go on, the police follow up a report that the child was seen with a white stranger, and rumors run wild. Before hapless, innocent Claude Packard is even found, popular hysteria has him tried and convicted. But is he guilty?
movies.title: The Well
movies.tagline: I have a wife and two kids ... a thing like this can ruin me !

movies.overview: Foreign correspondent Pete Garvey has 5 days to win back his former fiancée, or he'll lose the orphans he adopted.
movies.title: Here Comes the Groom

movies.overview: An arrogant reporter exploits a story about a man trapped in a cave to revitalize his career.
movies.title: Ace in the Hole
movies.tagline: Rough, tough Chuck Tatum, who battered his way to the top... trampling everything in his path - men, women and morals !

movies.overview: A melancholy poet reflects on three women he loved and lost in the past: a mechanical performing doll, a Venetian courtesan, and the consumptive daughter of a celebrated composer.
movies.title: The Tales of Hoffmann
movies.tagline: You Will Never See Anything Finer On The Screen!

movies.overview: A tribute to the U.S. 442nd Regimental Combat Team, formed in 1943 by Presidential permission with Japanese-American volunteers. We follow the training of a platoon under the rueful command of Lt. Mike Grayson who shares common prejudices of the time. The 442nd serve in Italy, then France, distinguishing themselves in skirmishes and battles; gradually and naturally, Grayson's prejudices evaporate with dawning realization that his men are better soldiers than he is.
movies.title: Go for Broke!
movies.tagline: The story of Japanese-American soldiers who fought in Europe during World War II

movies.overview: A matador must recover his courage after being gored in the ring.
movies.title: The Brave Bulls
movies.tagline: For a moment ... he was afraid of nothing !

movies.overview: "Kon-Tiki" was the name of a wooden raft used by six Scandinavian scientists, led by Thor Heyerdahl, to make a 101-day journey from South America to the Polynesian Islands. The purpose of the expedition was to prove Heyerdal's theory that the Polynesian Islands were populated from the east- specifically Peru- rather than from the west (Asia) as had been the theory for hundreds of years. Heyerdahl made a study of the winds and tides in the Pacific, and by simulating conditions as closely as possible to those he theorized the Peruvians encountered, set out on the voyage.
movies.title: Kon-Tiki
movies.tagline: The Amazing Adventure Of Six Men On A Raft Across The Pacific! True! Thrilling!

movies.original_title: The Day the Earth Stood Still
movies.overview: An alien and a robot land on Earth after World War II and tell mankind to be peaceful or face destruction.
movies.title: The Day the Earth Stood Still
movies.tagline: From out of space...A warning and an ultimatum.
